collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: Two friends lie on the warm sand, pointing out shapes among the stars.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: Two friends lie on the warm sand, pointing out shapes among the stars. One of them insists a cluster of stars looks exactly like a sleeping pig.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: Two friends lie on the warm sand, pointing out shapes among the stars. They fall asleep before agreeing on a single shape.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: Two friends lie on the warm sand, pointing out shapes among the stars. A shooting star crosses the sky, and both of them forget what they were saying.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: Two friends lie on the warm sand, pointing out shapes among the stars. They decide to give their favorite star a name and keep it to themselves.
